root_cause: Composio Tavily search returned HTTP 432 plan limit despite ACTIVE authorization. Existing canonical producer had DataForSEO fallback but concurrent Tavily requests could repeat blocked requests.
change: Use one in-flight probe and bounded per-isolate cooldown for HTTP 432/429 before existing real DataForSEO fallback.
prevention: On the existing scheduler-owned bg-externe-signalen source, share one in-isolate Tavily probe. On provider 432 (plan limit), block repeat Tavily calls for 15 minutes; on 429 for 1 minute. Continue independently evidenced DataForSEO organic fallback, never bypass billing cap, duplicate scheduler, unauthorized egress, RLS or false-green source receipts. Regressions enforce this behavior and source lineage.
